scope: Metadata-only root verification; no EEG, questionnaire responses or weights downloaded.

candidates.access_verified: Official public API returned status OK. Unrestricted 5907-byte README was retrieved; restricted waveform files were not requested.
candidates.size_caveat: Includes alternative raw, preprocessed and epoched representations; not a count of unique EEG data. Raw uses split ZIP volumes.
candidates.continuous_evidence: README describes test_block containing whole test EEG blocks and aligned test_state_blocks with rest=0 and task-specific integer labels. Catalog describes randomly interleaved test blocks.
limits: Actual access requires request; no immediate unrestricted EEG availability claim.
Naturalistic no-control exposure, trial timing, channel count and complete consent/ethics evidence were not established by this metadata pass.
Structured rest is not automatically unrestricted daily idle.
Preprocessed representation includes ICA and filtering; causal online preprocessing must be separately audited.
Pickle derivatives require safe handling; prefer a reviewed loader and non-executable signal format where available.
Questionnaire response files are restricted and unnecessary for the proposed initial signal-only benchmark.
candidates.priority: High-interest future continuous mixed-task track, blocked on access and scientific/rights preflight; no access request sent.

candidates.verification: Primary paper retrieved through web search; dataset file manifest was not inspected.
candidates.task: left versus right hand motor imagery
candidates.preprocessing: Bad segments removed, baseline removed, 0.5-40 Hz FIR-filtered before disclosure; fewer trials in some sessions.
candidates.consent_ethics: Paper reports signed experimental consent and Shanghai Second Rehabilitation Hospital approval ECSHSRH 2018-0101.
limits: Do not infer dataset license from CC BY 4.0 article license.
Paper documents five sessions; exact gaps and reconstructible elapsed calibration time require event/file verification.
Pre-cleaned release cannot support claims of robustness to all raw artifacts.
candidates.priority: Candidate compact external chronological MI cohort after metadata and rights preflight.
